definitions_used_in_supplementary_diagno.local_std128: population standard deviation of the last 128 ER observations, ddof=0
definitions_used_in_supplementary_diagno.mean_abs_change127: mean of the 127 adjacent absolute ER changes within the 128-ER window
definitions_used_in_supplementary_diagno.state_switch127: adjacent switches among low<=0.2, mid(0.2,0.6), high>=0.6 divided by 127
definitions_used_in_supplementary_diagno.direct_extreme_switch127: adjacent low/high swaps only divided by 127
definitions_used_in_supplementary_diagno.price_basis: raw close primary; log close also computed as sensitivity
definitions_used_in_supplementary_diagno.clock: continuous supplied bar order; lunch/overnight gaps not filled

interpretation: The current C1 direction layer does not use rolling H16/W128 dynamics as a classifier input.
The main 5m two-cycle spans are often far longer than H=16, so existing C1 counts cannot be treated as proof that the short/medium-term H16/W128 state transitions have been captured.

The old 2015-2020 development period does not show 5m uniformly larger than 1m on local std128, while state_switch127 is modestly larger for the five 5m offsets under the repository's 0.2/0.6 diagnostic thresholds.
These are descriptive development diagnostics, not accuracy, fresh OOS, or trading results.
